services.name: Loon Cabin
services.desc: Situated in the heart of the Fraser Canyon, our cabins give you the comforts of home and a taste of the outdoors. Our lakeside and rustic cabins have wood burning stoves and all the amenities needed for cooking and eating. They also include a fridge, kitchen table with chairs, couches, private outdoor fire pits, and 1-3 rooms. If you enjoy the outdoors but like a little bit of "at home comfort”, come stay in one of our cabins for a weekend or even a week! Check-in: 4pm / Check-out: 11am.Damage deposit required upon check-in.There is a $10 per night fee for sharing your accommodations with your dogs. Rustic Cabin 8 is a quaint, one room cabin. Mere footsteps away from the lake to complete the experience with a cold plunge! Able to accommodate up to six guests for half-day or full-day

blurb: The Findlay Family invites you and yours to come experience tranquility at Blue Lake Resort. We are located 15km north of Boston Bar - just a short drive from Vancouver! Campground Manager Shayne Findlay wants you to see how Blue Lake is truly a place apart from anywhere else in the beautiful Fraser Canyon.
